name: INCKEN
recent: INCKEN 已完成以 RM42,205,000 将 Bangi 一幅约 6.03 公顷的永久地契土地出售给 MKH Berhad 全资子公司 Serentak Maju Corporation。公司近期也出现董事会及委员会人事变动，包括 Yazid bin Mohammad 与 Che Md Nawawi bin Ismail 的职位调整。

recent_en: INCKEN has completed the disposal of a parcel of freehold land in Bangi measuring about 6.03 hectares to Serentak Maju Corporation, a wholly-owned subsidiary of MKH Berhad, for RM42,205,000. The company also saw recent board and committee changes, including adjustments involving Yazid bin Mohammad and Che Md Nawawi bin Ismail.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of a parcel of freehold land in Bangi measuring about 6.03 hectares to Serentak Maju Corporation, a wholly-owned subsidiary of MKH Berhad, for RM42,205,000.
Yazid bin Mohammad had changes in boardroom and membership of the nomination, audit and remuneration committees.
Che Md Nawawi bin Ismail had changes in boardroom and membership of the nomination, audit and remuneration committees.
